description: This file contains utility functions related to network management, including security mode interpretation, signal strength conversion, device property retrieval, and logging level configuration within the WPEFramework plugin for NetworkManager on Raspberry Pi 4.

methods.name: nmUtils::wifiSecurityModeFromAp
methods.description: Determines Wi-Fi security mode from access point flags and security parameters.

methods.name: nmUtils::convertPercentageToSignalStrength
methods.description: Converts a percentage (0-100) to a dBm signal strength value.

methods.name: nmUtils::getSecurityModeString
methods.description: Generates a string describing the security mode based on flags.

methods.name: nmUtils::wifiFrequencyFromAp
methods.description: Determines Wi-Fi frequency band (2.4GHz, 5GHz, 6GHz) from frequency in MHz.

methods.name: nmUtils::caseInsensitiveCompare
methods.description: Performs case-insensitive comparison of two strings.

methods.name: nmUtils::getDeviceProperties
methods.description: Reads device properties from /etc/device.properties and updates internal variables.

methods.name: nmUtils::setNetworkManagerlogLevelToTrace
methods.description: Sets NetworkManager daemon log level to TRACE.

methods.name: nmUtils::setMarkerFile
methods.description: Creates or removes a marker file based on the 'unmark' parameter.

methods.name: nmUtils::isInterfaceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a network interface is enabled based on the presence of a disable marker file.

methods.name: nmUtils::writePersistentHostname
methods.description: Writes the device hostname to persistent storage.

methods.name: nmUtils::readPersistentHostname
methods.description: Reads the device hostname from persistent storage.
